description: This file is a CMake script defining a function `compile_aidl` used to generate source code from AIDL files during build time. It includes detailed documentation and implementation for invoking the aidl compiler with configurable parameters.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a custom CMake function to compile AIDL files into source code, supporting various options for specifying the aidl compiler path, flags, language, include directories, and output directory.
